description: Obtain facts of any resource using Azure REST API.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: api_version
parameters.description: Specific API version to be used.

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The HTTP method of the request or response. It must be uppercase. Choices: "GET" ← (default) "PUT" "POST" "HEAD" "PATCH" "DELETE" "MERGE"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider type, should be specified in no URL is given.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Resource group to be used. Required if URL is not specified.

parameters.name: resource_name
parameters.description: Resource name.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Resource type.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subresource
parameters.description: List of subresources. Default: []

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Subresource name.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Subresource namespace.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Subresource type.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary of tags to filter on. Each key-value pair in the dictionary specifies a tag name and its value to filter on differente resources. Default: {}

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Azure RM Resource URL.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get scaleset info
  azure_rm_resource_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    provider: compute
    resource_type: virtualmachinescalesets
    resource_name: myVmss
    api_version: "2017-12-01"

- name: Query all the resources in the resource group
  azure_rm_resource_info:
    resource_group: "{{ resource_group }}"
    resource_type: resources

- name: Get all snapshots of all resource groups of a subscription but filtering with two tags.
  azure_rm_resource_info:
    provider: compute
    resource_type: snapshots
    tags:
      enviroment: dev
      department: hr

return_values.name: response
return_values.description: Response specific to resource type. Returned: always

return_values.description: Id of the Azure resource. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxx...xxxx/resourceGroups/v-xisuRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/myVM"

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: Resource location. Returned: always Sample: "eastus"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Resource name. Returned: always Sample: "myVM"

return_values.name: properties
return_values.description: Specifies the virtual machine’s property. Returned: always

return_values.name: diagnosticsProfile
return_values.description: Specifies the boot diagnostic settings state. Returned: always

return_values.name: bootDiagnostics
return_values.description: A debugging feature, which to view Console Output and Screenshot to diagnose VM status. Returned: always Sample: {"enabled": true, "storageUri": "https://vxisurgdiag.blob.core.windows.net/"}

return_values.name: hardwareProfile
return_values.description: Specifies the hardware settings for the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: {"vmSize": "Standard_D2s_v3"}

return_values.name: networkProfile
return_values.description: Specifies the network interfaces of the virtual machine. Returned: always

return_values.name: networkInterfaces
return_values.description: Describes a network interface reference. Returned: always Sample: [{"id": "/subscriptions/xxxx...xxxx/resourceGroups/v-xisuRG/providers/Microsoft.Network/networkInterfaces/myvm441"}]

return_values.name: osProfile
return_values.description: Specifies the operating system settings for the virtual machine. Returned: always

return_values.name: adminUsername
return_values.description: Specifies the name of the administrator account. Returned: always Sample: "azureuser"

return_values.name: allowExtensionOperations
return_values.description: Specifies whether extension operations should be allowed on the virtual machine. This may only be set to False when no extensions are present on the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: computerName
return_values.description: Specifies the host OS name of the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: "myVM"

return_values.name: linuxConfiguration
return_values.description: Specifies the Linux operating system settings on the virtual machine. Returned: when OS type is Linux Sample: {"disablePasswordAuthentication": false, "provisionVMAgent": true}

return_values.name: requireGuestProvisionSignale
return_values.description: Specifies the host require guest provision signal or not. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: secrets
return_values.description: Specifies set of certificates that should be installed onto the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: provisioningState
return_values.description: The provisioning state. Returned: always Sample: "Succeeded"

return_values.name: storageProfile
return_values.description: Specifies the storage account type for the managed disk. Returned: always

return_values.name: dataDisks
return_values.description: Specifies the parameters that are used to add a data disk to virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: [{"caching": "None", "createOption": "Attach", "diskSizeGB": 1023, "lun": 2, "managedDisk": {"id": "/subscriptions/xxxx....xxxx/resourceGroups/V-XISURG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/disks/testdisk2", "storageAccountType": "StandardSSD_LRS"}, "name": "testdisk2"}, {"caching": "None", "createOption": "Attach", "diskSizeGB": 1023, "lun": 1, "managedDisk": {"id": "/subscriptions/xxxx...xxxx/resourceGroups/V-XISURG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/disks/testdisk3", "storageAccountType": "StandardSSD_LRS"}, "name": "testdisk3"}]

return_values.name: imageReference
return_values.description: Specifies information about the image to use. Returned: always Sample: {"offer": "UbuntuServer", "publisher": "Canonical", "sku": "20_04-lts", "version": "latest"}

return_values.name: osDisk
return_values.description: Specifies information about the operating system disk used by the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: {"caching": "ReadWrite", "createOption": "FromImage", "diskSizeGB": 30, "managedDisk": {"id": "/subscriptions/xxx...xxxx/resourceGroups/v-xisuRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/disks/myVM_disk1_xxx", "storageAccountType": "Premium_LRS"}, "name": "myVM_disk1_xxx", "osType": "Linux"}

return_values.name: vmID
return_values.description: Specifies the VM unique ID which is a 128-bits identifier that is encoded and stored in all Azure laaS VMs SMBIOS. It can be read using platform BIOS commands. Returned: always Sample: "eb86d9bb-6725-4787-a487-2e497d5b340c"

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The type of identity used for the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines"
